root_idea.summary: The root centers on going forth freely and without hindrance.
root_idea.development: From outward movement come the senses of sending livestock to pasture, proceeding easily or swiftly, and releasing or dismissing someone. Several derived usages extend this idea to flowing, becoming clear, being unclothed, and spreading outward.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form.
Displayed under the normalized Form II perfect citation form.
Displayed as the verbal noun تَسْرِيح.

senses.definition: To send livestock out to pasture; to go out to pasture.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrence, the livestock are understood as the object of sending, and the verb describes their going out for grazing.

senses.definition: To release or dismiss, especially to release a wife by divorce.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrences concern releasing a wife and letting her go without retaining her; the construction expresses an orderly or kindly dismissal.

senses.definition: Release or dismissal; specifically, the dismissal of a wife by divorce.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, the noun denotes divorce understood as a formal release or letting go.

senses.definition: Releasing or dismissing a wife by divorce.
senses.usage_conditions: This verbal noun names the act of releasing in the marital-divorce construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To defame people, especially in their absence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative usage derived from the image of grazing freely among people's reputations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To depart, go away, or proceed easily.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of going out in the morning and of proceeding easily in one's affairs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To flow or run freely.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a torrent and of urine flowing after having been suppressed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To send a messenger or send someone to a place or task.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive sending construction distinct from sending livestock to pasture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To dispose or adapt someone to what is good.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare figurative and explicitly attributed usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To void excrement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily-function usage, also reported for excrement in a thin state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bring forth or reveal what is held within oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used figuratively of expressing what is in the breast or bosom.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To send away, remove, alienate, or estrange.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general removal or putting-away construction, broader than the Quranic marital use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remove or clear away grief or sorrow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figurative causative usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause water to flow or let it flow into a channel or enclosure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used transitively of directing or releasing water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To comb, loosen, disentangle, or arrange hair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage can include letting down, separating, and combing the hair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To trim or refine poetry or verses.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized usage applied to a poet's treatment of verse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To facilitate or make something easy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative usage of rendering an action or matter easy.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go away or go forth from a place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reflexive or intransitive Form V usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To move along quickly and easily.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially of a she-camel becoming easy and swift in her pace.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To lie on one's back extended, with the legs parted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily-position usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become naked or bare.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of being without clothing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become relieved or cleared away, especially of grief or sorrow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Intransitive or quasi-passive figurative usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Livestock pasturing; by extension, livestock or camels that pasture.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may refer to the activity, a single beast, or a collection of beasts.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A large, tall tree, often valued for its spreading shade.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is also used collectively for such trees; its botanical identification is described variably.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wife or woman, by metonymy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative nominal use of the name of the tree.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The exterior court or yard of a house, gate, or door.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal architectural sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Easy, swift, and unhindered in movement or performance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a camel, horse, gait, the movement of a limb, an easy birth or draught of water, and figuratively of a promptly given gift.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A single tree of the kind called سَرْح.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Singular noun for the tree sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mature she-ass that has not become pregnant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The name of a certain dog.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A proper-name usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wolf; in one dialect, a lion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The animal designation is also used as a masculine noun and has several plural forms.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The false or first dawn.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic expression derived from the wolf or lion designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A name given to certain dogs and horses.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are proper-name usages rather than a general animal classification.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The middle part of a watering trough or tank.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized material noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dismissal or sending away in a general sense.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Classical usage broader than the Quranic divorce sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Haste, expedition, or promptness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal sense of quick, unhindered completion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Ease and rest.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the fixed expression فِي سَرَاحٍ وَرَوَاحٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The name of a certain horse, probably conveying quick and easy pace.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An indeclinable proper name whose lexical interpretation is inferential.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Quick, expeditious, or prompt.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an affair or bounty accomplished without delay.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Without a saddle, of a horse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized equestrian usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thong or strap used for sandals, camel footwear, or similar fastening.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may denote a single strap or related sandal components.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sinew binding or conspicuous mark on an arrow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Specialized terminology for arrow construction or appearance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A piece of a garment that has been much torn.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A material noun, also reported with collective plural usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An elongated, conspicuous strip or tract of ground richer in vegetation than its surroundings.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The tract is described as even or narrow and rising above or standing out from the surrounding land.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An elongated tract of flowing blood.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of blood when spread out in a strip.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Tall, as an epithet for a man.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A locust; also used for a female locust.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An animal noun with the feminine expression أُمُّ سِرْيَاحٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The name of a certain woman.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare proper-name usage reported in one instance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The name of a certain dog.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A proper-name usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The name of a horse, probably meaning swift or easy-paced.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical interpretation is explicitly presented as probable.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A herder who sends livestock to pasture; also a person or group possessing grazing livestock.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The active participle is also substantivized for the herder or the people associated with the grazing herd.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the expression مَا لَهُ سَارِحَةٌ وَلَا رَائِحَةٌ: anything at all, or, by negation, nothing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed figurative expression originally contrasting livestock going to and returning from pasture; it can also refer to people or a group.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Flowing easily, of a torrent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of a freely running torrent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A pasture or place to which animals are sent out to graze.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The place may be near or distant from the settlement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A comb.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for the implement used in combing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One of the two wooden pieces bound around a ploughing bull's neck as part of a yoke.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Usually encountered in the dual form مِسْرَحَانِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An instrument for separating and combing hair, flax, or similar fibers.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized combing and carding implement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mirage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare dialectal attribution whose correctness is reported as uncertain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Lying on one's back extended, with the legs parted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily-position usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Denuded or lightly clad; stripped of clothing or, of a camel, of its fur.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression may be literal or figurative, including being divested of the apparel of generosity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The name of a type of Arabic poetic meter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical prosodic term.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Livestock grazing is covered by the Form I pasture sense.
Transitive sending of livestock to pasture, including the Quran citation.
Proceeding easily is covered by the broader departure sense.
Divorce dismissal and letting the wife go.
Botanical identification and editorial detail for the tree sense; it adds no independent lexical meaning.
Single tree of the سرح kind.
Nominal divorce sense with Quran citation.
Horse proper name with probable interpretation.
Pointer to the related easy/swift entry.
Thongs and the related arrow terminology.
Fixed expression meaning nothing or anything at all.
Shepherd or group with grazing livestock.
Camel divested of fur is covered by the broader denuded sense.

cautions: The Form I public headword is normalized to the perfect citation form سَرَحَ; the supplied Quran occurrence is an imperfect inflection.
Several rare animal-name, botanical, and dialectal senses are retained because Lane presents them as lexical usages, while uncertain interpretations are marked in their usage conditions.
